title: OtterWorks audit event (contract v2)
description: Body of POST /api/v1/audit/events on audit-service. See docs/audit-events.md.

userId.description: Actor id (gateway X-User-ID or the service's own JWT subject), or "anonymous".

actorEmail.description: Actor email (gateway X-User-Email or JWT email claim).

action.description: Dot-namespaced action, e.g. auth.login.success. The common single-word actions export and delete are also accepted.

details.description: Flat string map of non-sensitive context. Never passwords, JWT/refresh/share tokens, credentials or file/document contents.

ipAddress.description: Client IP: first X-Forwarded-For entry, then X-Real-IP, then socket address.

sourceIp.description: Alias of ipAddress. If both are sent, ipAddress wins.

requestId.description: The X-Request-ID of the originating request.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 time of the action. Defaults to the time audit-service received the event.
